turn.reply:
Pehle samjho ki problem ke liye kaunsa rule chahiye.

Ray normal se 30° par aa rahi hai. Humein reflection angle nikaalna hai. Pehle reference line pehchano: normal surface ke perpendicular hota hai aur angle isi line se naapte hain.

Is explanation ka kaunsa hissa tumhe understanding check solve karne mein madad karta hai?

sources.title: Laws of reflection
sources.rights: Original ScortIQ project notes; internal pilot only
sources.excerpt: The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection. Both angles are measured from the normal, an imaginary line perpendicular to the surface. The incident ray, reflected ray and normal lie in the same plane.

sources.title: Laws of reflection
sources.rights: Original ScortIQ project notes; internal pilot only
sources.excerpt: A ray arriving at 30° to the normal leaves at 30° to the normal.
